correct_completion: many studies show that productivity has actually increased.
full_sentence: Although critics argue that remote work weakens team cohesion, many studies show that productivity has actually increased.
acceptable_variants: several recent surveys report that employees feel more productive at home.
the evidence on productivity is more positive than expected.

options.text: the policy should therefore be abandoned.

options.why_wrong: This describes a trend but does not set up a contrast with the criticism in the stem.

teams in the same city tend to communicate more often.
options.why_wrong: This supports the criticism rather than contrasting with it, so it breaks the concessive structure.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Ukrainian speakers sometimes add a second contrast marker in the main clause, but English needs only one contrast connector in this structure.
